items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gerry Wald, in the mid-forties, for a short period.

ctx.x: It was a band with Joe Puma, leading it a female leader, and some of my friends. We went to Port Arthur, Texas. That was the whole gig for a week or two. I didn’t go back to school. I think I just wanted to work and I convinced them [parents] that I should be independent. Unfortunately I missed that.
I read at some point you played with Gerry Wald?
Gerry Wald, in the mid-forties, for a short period.
